transform: Existing-data disjoint calibration, formal_entry, fixed fold0; freeze artifact digests before any new generation.
source_scope: New to this project's generation history after overlap audit; no claim that benchmark problems were absent from model pretraining. Textbook domain differs from original miniF2F.
units: Equal weight of independent exercise groups, with textbook plus exercise stem grouping subparts; average eligible attempts within problem then problems within group.

primary_family.method: Bonferroni: individual two-sided 97.5% task-group bootstrap interval for Goedel, one-sided exact positional permutation p <= .025 for DeepSeek.
primary_family.goedel: Mean equal-exercise-group difference of top1 jump minus top1 surprisal over eligible first-failure-localized traces.
primary_family.deepseek: Error after first observation; exclude first increment; choose one deterministic trace per exercise group; exact permutation of error indices within textbook and exact eligible length; require at least 20 matched independent groups.

ties: Lowest original source index; report tie frequency.
boundaries: No clipping or wrapping. D=j-tstar. Missing offsets are misses in unconditional rate; report offset-available conditional rates. Main D0; shifts and window descriptive.
selection: No labels or scores from new responses used to select problems or settings. Reference compilation, holes/axioms, exact and exercise-family overlap checks precede generation.
technical_pilot_scope: Disjoint exercise groups used only for acquisition checks, never pooled into confirmatory evaluation. No semantic success gate or endpoint tuning.
primary_missing: Report all assigned attempts and exclusion categories. Confirmatory outcomes conditional on reliably localized failed traces; do not substitute malformed, incomplete or runtime failures as localized errors.
stopping: Fixed complete compatible heldout corpus, four attempts per task; no stopping or extension based on p-values.
secondary: position predictor trained only on old calibration tasks
